561122564commit.h: C. Henry Jr. picks LSU after a price negotiation that scared off rivals
561122564commit.d: The five-star receiver's reported $620K ask kept some suitors from getting serious. [[t:832438333|LSU]] met it and sold [[r:561122564|C. Henry Jr.]] on a passing game that moves.

quote.text: It's a business too. They made it make sense.

561122034commit.h: Alabama's DB pipeline wins J. Edwards over Tennessee and Oregon
561122034commit.d: [[r:561122034|J. Edwards]] looked hard at [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] and [[t:832438364|Oregon]]. In the end, [[t:832438274|Alabama]]'s record of putting defensive backs in the league, plus a thin safety room, won out.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.

561122097commit.h: Indiana lands No. 11 overall I. Iheanacho, and winning did the recruiting
561122097commit.d: A top-15 tackle picks a [[t:832438319|Indiana]] program that is 11-3 and ranked No. 7. A source close to [[r:561122097|I. Iheanacho]] says the staff's track record of developing linemen for the pros sealed it.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.
quote.by: a source close to [[r:561122097|I. Iheanacho]]

561122106commit.h: Colorado hands No. 14 overall J. Waletzko the keys to a quick start
561122106commit.d: [[t:832438295|Colorado]] is 15-1 and ranked No. 4, and it told [[r:561122106|J. Waletzko]] he can play right away. For a top-15 talent, that combination is hard to beat.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

561122591commit.h: Miami's title pitch lands J. Edmonds over LSU and Indiana
561122591commit.d: [[r:561122591|J. Edmonds]] wanted a title shot and a clear path to the field. [[t:832438337|Miami]] offered both. Rivals [[t:832438333|LSU]] and [[t:832438319|Indiana]] were left to regroup.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

561121891commit.h: Ole Miss pays up and pitches an open job to land QB C. Fleming
561121891commit.d: A reported $385K ask didn't scare [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] off. Per a source, [[r:561121891|C. Fleming]] studied the quarterback room and liked what he saw.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

561119757commit.h: Indiana keeps E. DaSilva close to West Bloomfield and wins a tug-of-war
561119757commit.d: The five-star edge rusher heard from several programs. A short drive for his family and a real title pitch got [[t:832438319|Indiana]] the commitment, according to a person close to [[r:561119757|E. DaSilva]].

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

561120349commit.h: Indiana adds another five-star edge in I. Epenesa, and the depth chart is getting crowded
561120349commit.d: [[t:832438319|Indiana]]'s staff promised [[r:561120349|I. Epenesa]] a real shot at the job, and the short trip from Glen Carbon helped. The pass rush is loaded, and someone will have to wait.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

561120631commit.h: Utah holds off Michigan and Indiana to land five-star D. Iorio
561120631commit.d: [[r:561120631|D. Iorio]] chose [[t:832438400|Utah]] over [[t:832438339|Michigan]] and [[t:832438319|Indiana]], and the finish was tighter than the staff let on. A source says the linebacker room and the defensive scheme were the difference.

quote.text: The way they use guys like me, I fit perfect.

561124114commit.h: C. Virgin picks Colorado over SMU and Notre Dame, and the message is clear
561124114commit.d: [[t:832438295|Colorado]], 15-1 and ranked No. 4, sold [[r:561124114|C. Virgin]] on a quick path to the field. [[t:832438375|SMU]] and [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] both pushed. Neither could match the pitch.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

561122564sign.h: C. Henry Jr. makes it official with LSU after a pricey chase
561122564sign.d: The former Ohio State receiver is signed. Per a source, the final negotiation with [[t:832438333|LSU]] got done quickly once [[r:561122564|C. Henry Jr.]] saw the reported $620K number he wanted.

561121023sign.h: Tennessee signs five-star QB F. Brandon on a passing-game pitch
561121023sign.d: [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] has the nation's top passing offense, and [[r:561121023|F. Brandon]] is the next piece. If the Vols can keep landing stars like this, the title pitch gets easier.

561121915sign.h: Notre Dame signs five-star CB B. Arrington into a thin room
561121915sign.d: [[r:561121915|B. Arrington]] is [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]]'s latest five-star signing. With only two cornerbacks back, he could see the field as a freshman, and a source says the staff made that clear.

561121027sign.h: LSU signs T. Keys, and now the receiver room is loaded
561121027sign.d: [[r:561121027|T. Keys]] wanted a power-conference stage and picked [[t:832438333|LSU]]. A source says the staff pitched him a role alongside [[r:561122564|C. Henry Jr.]], not behind him.

561122239sign.h: Notre Dame seals five-star safety J. O'Brien with national-stage pitch
561122239sign.d: [[r:561122239|J. O'Brien]] wanted maximum exposure, and [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]]'s brand delivered. It was the big-stage pitch that closed this one.

561119403sign.h: J. Cantwell signs with Notre Dame after an early-playing-time pitch
561119403sign.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]]'s staff told [[r:561119403|J. Cantwell]] he can compete for a job right away. A source close to the program says the Irish keep winning recruits with that message.

561122034sign.h: J. Edwards signs with Alabama, betting on its defensive back factory
561122034sign.d: [[r:561122034|J. Edwards]] is officially a Crimson Tide signee. [[t:832438274|Alabama]]'s history of producing DBs for the league convinced him, and a source says the staff's follow-up calls were relentless.

561123004sign.h: K. Adams signs with Notre Dame, chasing a title
561123004sign.d: [[r:561123004|K. Adams]] wanted a championship contender, and [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] grades out at the top of the list. The Irish run through signing day keeps rolling.

561121465sign.h: Oklahoma lands five-star Z. Elee as the NIL checks keep clearing
561121465sign.d: [[r:561121465|Z. Elee]] fits a pass rush that is among the nation's best. A source says [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]]'s NIL money didn't hurt, and rival staffs are taking notice.

561122097sign.h: Indiana makes I. Iheanacho's commitment official
561122097sign.d: [[t:832438319|Indiana]] has its franchise left tackle. [[r:561122097|I. Iheanacho]] signed after a recruitment that leaned on the program's record of sending linemen to the pros.

561119362sign.h: Oregon signs C. Morgan, who wanted a shot at a title
561119362sign.d: [[r:561119362|C. Morgan]] is official with [[t:832438364|Oregon]]. A source says the Ducks' championship pitch carried the day, a small win for a program that has had a tough week in recruiting.

561123022sign.h: D. Odoms signs with Miami for the offense and the pace
561123022sign.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]]'s offense is one of the nation's most productive, and [[r:561123022|D. Odoms]] saw an agile playmaker's dream. A source says the Hurricanes' staff sold the scheme on every visit.

561122106sign.h: Colorado makes J. Waletzko's signing official
561122106sign.d: The No. 14 overall prospect is signed, and [[t:832438295|Colorado]] has already told [[r:561122106|J. Waletzko]] to prepare to compete for a job. The Buffs' winning record sold the rest.

561121848sign.h: X. Griffin signs with Indiana and another title-seeker joins the class
561121848sign.d: [[r:561121848|X. Griffin]] wanted a contender, and [[t:832438319|Indiana]] has become one. The Hoosiers' class keeps growing, and rivals are scrambling.

561120849sign.h: K. Obot signs with Notre Dame, the latest in a heavy week
561120849sign.d: [[r:561120849|K. Obot]] wanted a title shot, and [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] provided it. The Irish have been closing hard, and rival recruiters admit it.

561122591sign.h: J. Edmonds signs with Miami, and the CB room gets a lift
561122591sign.d: [[r:561122591|J. Edmonds]] is official with [[t:832438337|Miami]]. The program's win over Ohio State is still paying off on the trail, and a title shot was the draw.

561121698sign.h: Oklahoma seals five-star REDG C. Meadows, doubling down on its pass rush
561121698sign.d: [[r:561121698|C. Meadows]] joins [[r:561121465|Z. Elee]] at [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]]. A source says the NIL spending was a factor, but the scheme sold him too.

561121891sign.h: C. Fleming signs with Ole Miss and gets his shot at the QB job
561121891sign.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] told [[r:561121891|C. Fleming]] he could compete immediately. A source close to the program says the staff is already planning for him to push for the starting job.

561122048sign.h: Georgia seals five-star WILL T. Atkinson with a playing-time pitch
561122048sign.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] told [[r:561122048|T. Atkinson]] he can compete for a job right away. The win comes as the staff tries to show it can hold its own roster too, after keeping J. Smith.

561121222sign.h: D. Odem III signs with Notre Dame, and the CB room is now crowded
561121222sign.d: [[r:561121222|D. Odem III]] joins [[r:561121915|B. Arrington]] in a cornerback room that was thin. A source says the staff pitched an open competition, and now it has one.

561119757sign.h: E. DaSilva makes it official, picks Indiana to chase a title
561119757sign.d: The Hoosiers keep stacking their class. Indiana's championship-contender profile was the hook, and DaSilva's camp reportedly never took another visit seriously once the Hoosiers got serious.

quote.text: He wanted to play for a title, and Indiana was the only place that felt like that every day.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

561120349sign.h: Indiana adds five-star edge I. Epenesa, and the class keeps growing
561120349sign.d: Epenesa signs with Indiana after the staff told him he could compete for a starting job right away. Rival recruiters say the Hoosiers' pitch of playing time plus a title window is hard to beat.

quote.text: Nobody else was straight with him about snaps like Indiana was.
quote.by: a rival recruiter

561120631sign.h: Utah closes on five-star D. Iorio and wins a tug-of-war
561120631sign.d: The scheme fit sold Iorio. Utah ranks 7th in total tackles (173), and a hitter at SAM saw himself in that defense. Staffs around the league had spent weeks hoping he'd drift elsewhere.

quote.text: He watched Utah's tape and said, 'That's where I'd be flying around.'
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

561124114sign.h: Colorado signs five-star athlete C. Virgin on a playing-time pitch
561124114sign.d: Virgin picks Colorado after being told a job is there to compete for from day one. The staff has been selling versatility all cycle, and this was the payoff.

quote.text: They told him he'd touch the ball and he believed them.
quote.by: a person familiar with the recruitment

561119527commit.h: N. Burroughs picks Georgia over Florida State and Georgia Tech
561119527commit.d: Georgia has just two returning receivers, and its NIL spending ranks 3rd. Burroughs reportedly asked for $340K, and the Bulldogs were willing to meet it. Florida State and Georgia Tech were left on the outside.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.
quote.by: N. Burroughs

561121982commit.h: D. Geralds chooses Auburn, calling the NFL track record the difference
561121982commit.d: Auburn has sent four defensive linemen to the draft in four years, one in the first round, and has just three returning tackles. Illinois and Michigan both thought they were in good shape late.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.
quote.by: D. Geralds

561120261commit.h: B. Hanks III picks Florida State over Clemson and Auburn
561120261commit.d: With just three returning corners, Florida State offered a quick path to the field. The Seminoles' conference prestige did the rest, and Clemson's staff is said to be disappointed.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.
quote.by: B. Hanks III

561125191commit.h: Oregon lands four-star guard D. Lee on a ring-chasing pitch
561125191commit.d: Oregon grades out an A+ as a championship contender and has just two returning guards. Lee's camp reportedly liked how quickly the Ducks laid out his path to the field.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.
quote.by: D. Lee

561121944commit.h: Iron Bowl win helps Auburn land Z. Helton from Florida and Alabama
561121944commit.d: Auburn's 47-42 rivalry win over Alabama came at just the right time. Helton was in the stands, and the short drive from Carrollton made the decision easier. Alabama's staff reportedly knew the game hurt them.

quote.text: That win over Alabama? I was in the stands. That's when I knew.
quote.by: Z. Helton

557720545:stayed:2027.h: Ohio State keeps A. Rogers after five weeks on Portal Watch
557720545:stayed:2027.d: A. Rogers was buried on the depth chart and looked like a likely departure. He's still on the roster. The Buckeyes needed a win in a week full of bad news, and reportedly got one with a direct sales job.

quote.text: They had to sell him on the plan, and they did.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557724828:stayed:2027.h: Michigan talks flight risk S. Hiter into staying with a bigger NIL deal
557724828:stayed:2027.d: Hiter spent six weeks on Portal Watch while stuck on a losing team. Michigan's answer was money: his NIL rose from 115K to 195K. The decision was not an easy one for him.

quote.text: That one was closer than people think.
quote.by: a person close to the situation

557726826:stayed:2027.h: Penn State holds on to J. Zayas despite scheme-fit chatter
557726826:stayed:2027.d: Zayas had been tagged on Portal Watch as a bad fit, but he's still on the roster. agerm40's staff gets a quiet win during a noisy portal period.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557719002:stayed:2027.h: N. Pullard sticks at Penn State after a rating jump
557719002:stayed:2027.d: Pullard's rating bump made him a potential target for bigger offers, but he's remaining with the Nittany Lions. agerm40 needed some stability after a week of departures.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557711879:stayed:2027.h: J. Blue isn't leaving Ohio State, whatever Portal Watch said
557711879:stayed:2027.d: Blue's rating jump had him on the list, but he's still a Buckeye. Tuddy_roosevelt's staff takes a small positive in a rough portal week.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557714154:stayed:2027.h: Ohio State keeps S. Boyce out of the portal
557714154:stayed:2027.d: Boyce was about to get expensive after a rating jump and drew attention elsewhere, but he is staying. The Buckeyes are counting every player they keep.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

832438359:exodus:2027.h: Ohio State loses 19 to the portal, 14 of them four-stars or better
832438359:exodus:2027.d: Chris Henry Jr., Jerquaden Guilford and Tavien St. Clair are among those gone. Tuddy_roosevelt now faces the biggest rebuild in the league, and boosters are said to be watching how fast he responds.

quote.text: You can't lose this many talented players and say it's normal.
quote.by: a rival staffer

832438366:exodus:2027.h: Penn State sees 13 players enter the portal, three of them four-stars
832438366:exodus:2027.d: Jahmir Joseph, Christian Flanagan and Owen Aliciene lead the group out. agerm40 has holes at corner and quarterback, and the next few weeks will show whether he can fill them.

quote.text: It's a lot of change in the secondary and at quarterback.
quote.by: a source close to the program

832438301:exodus:2027.h: East Carolina sees 12 players leave, edge rusher Ethan Wilson among them
832438301:exodus:2027.d: Ethan Wilson, Ashton Gray and Donnell Mitchell lead a dozen portal entries. Pirate_flag now has to find an edge presence and replace depth at skill spots.

quote.text: Losing Wilson hurts. That's the one they'll feel most.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557722831:gone:2027.h: I. West leaves Ohio State, just as TD Wire flagged
557722831:gone:2027.d: West spent four weeks buried on the depth chart and is now in the portal. He is one more name leaving Tuddy_roosevelt's roster.

quote.text: He didn't see playing time coming. It was time to look.
quote.by: a person close to the player

557727811:gone:2027.h: D. Jones leaves Ohio State's depth chart behind for the portal
557727811:gone:2027.d: Jones had been flagged for two weeks, stuck behind others. He's now gone, leaving another hole in Tuddy_roosevelt's rebuild.

quote.text: He wanted a real shot to play and didn't feel he'd get one.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557717122:gone:2027.h: J. Joseph exits Penn State, a scheme mismatch that finally cracked
557717122:gone:2027.d: Joseph had been flagged for three weeks as a bad fit. He's now in the portal. agerm40 loses a four-star corner and a lot of secondary depth.

quote.text: He never felt comfortable in what they asked him to do.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557713037:gone:2027.h: C. Flanagan enters the portal and Penn State needs a quarterback plan
557713037:gone:2027.d: Flanagan's rating jump made him a prime target. He's now in the portal, and agerm40 has a hole at a premium position.

quote.text: Teams are going to call him all week. He has a market.
quote.by: a rival staffer

557723610:gone:2027.h: L. Andrews leaves Penn State as the scheme-fit warning comes true
557723610:gone:2027.d: Andrews was flagged for a week as a bad fit for the scheme. He is now in the portal, adding to a rough run for agerm40.

quote.text: It never really clicked for him.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557721477:gone:2027.h: T. St. Clair, under fire for his numbers, enters the portal
557721477:gone:2027.d: St. Clair had been flagged for a week while taking heat for his production. He is gone from Ohio State, one more quarterback question for Tuddy_roosevelt.

quote.text: He knew it was time for a fresh start.
quote.by: a person close to the player

557717043:struggling.h: Is LSU ready to move on from running back D. Jones?
557717043:struggling.d: Jones has 69 carries for 230 yards, just 3.3 a carry. That is not enough for an 85-overall back on a ranked team, and the staff has a big decision to make before next season.

quote.text: The production just hasn't matched the rating.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557725326:struggling.h: USC Fans Are Restless as R. Marriott Piles Up Interceptions
557725326:struggling.d: [[p:557725326|R.Marriott]] has thrown 14 picks against 13 touchdowns, with a 142.0 rating. [[t:832438398|USC]] could be looking at the portal for a quarterback, and the Trojans' supporters aren't hiding their frustration.

quote.text: Nobody's happy with the turnovers. The staff has to look at every option.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557722672:struggling.h: Ratings say 86. The stat sheet says something else for J. Washington
557722672:struggling.d: Washington has 106 carries for 421 yards, 4.0 a carry, which falls short of what an 86-overall back should deliver. The staff has a big decision to make before next season.

quote.text: The rating says one thing. The tape says another.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557719383:stayed:2027.h: I. Obidegwu stays at Oregon after a month on Portal Watch
557719383:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557719383|I.Obidegwu]] sat on the list for four weeks as a questionable scheme fit. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438364|Oregon]] roster. A raise in NIL, from 155K to 195K, seems to have helped.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557718302:underpaid.h: J. Mbatchou is playing for nothing. Florida is one team that could change that
557718302:underpaid.d: [[p:557718302|J.Mbatchou]] is an 85-overall defensive tackle with no NIL deal, while comparable players command around 105K. Per one source, [[t:832438308|Florida]] has been mentioned by agents as a suitor with the cash to close that gap.

quote.text: A guy rated like that doesn't stay unpaid once the portal calls start.
quote.by: an agent who works with SEC players

557725988:underpaid.h: A. Rowden Earns Nothing at Texas Tech, and Rival Collectives Are Calling
557725988:underpaid.d: An 86-overall running back with no NIL deal is an easy target when comparable backs command around 85K. [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] has the money. [[p:557725988|A.Rowden]] is waiting to see if it uses it.

quote.text: It's only a matter of time before somebody offers him real money.
quote.by: a source familiar with the market

557723756:underpaid.h: Rival collectives are circling James Madison's K. Billiot
557723756:underpaid.d: [[p:557723756|K.Billiot]] is an 86-overall receiver with no NIL deal, while his peers get around 90K. [[t:832438323|James Madison]] ranks 80th in NIL spending and isn't built for a bidding war. Several bigger collectives are reportedly aware of the gap.

quote.text: You can't pay him what the big boys will. That's just reality.
quote.by: a source familiar with JMU's NIL operation

557719085:buried.h: K. Mothudi is too good to sit. A transfer looks likely
557719085:buried.d: [[p:557719085|K.Mothudi]] is an 84-overall junior middle linebacker who played just 86 snaps in 13 games. Staffs in the portal market have noticed, and one told us he would start for them tomorrow.

quote.text: He's a starter everywhere but where he is.
quote.by: a portal-market staffer

557712371:sinking.h: K. Blackwell is wasted on a 4-8 Kentucky team and could be the portal's top prize
557712371:sinking.d: [[p:557712371|K.Blackwell]] is an 88-overall junior cornerback stuck on a Kentucky team that finished 4-8. If he enters the portal, he'd be the story of the offseason. Contenders needing secondary help are said to be waiting.

quote.text: Every contender with a hole at corner has his number written down.
quote.by: a rival recruiting staffer

561125249battle.h: Miami Holds Razor-Thin Edge for K. Kane, but Georgia Won't Back Down
561125249battle.d: The four-star back is down to a playing-time decision. [[t:832438337|Miami]] has the slight lead over [[t:832438312|Georgia]], and Missouri is lurking. One more strong week could settle it.

quote.text: He wants to know where he's touching the ball in September. Whoever shows him that wins.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

557722079:breakout.h: Freshman Tackle S. Orlando Is Playing Himself Into a Raise Northwestern May Not Cover
557722079:breakout.d: [[p:557722079|S.Orlando]] has leaped to 77 overall and is earning nothing in NIL. [[t:832438356|Northwestern]] ranks 75th in NIL spending, and rival staffs have noticed.

quote.text: You see that tape and you wonder who's even paying him. Somebody should be calling.
quote.by: a rival assistant coach

557720529:breakout.h: P.Carver's Rapid Rise Puts Louisiana Tech in a Bind
557720529:breakout.d: The freshman receiver is up 15 points to 78 overall and earns nothing in NIL. [[t:832438331|Louisiana Tech]] ranks 125th in NIL spending. [[p:557720529|P.Carver]] is exactly the type of player who gets a text from a bigger program.

quote.text: Guys like that don't stay quiet for long. Everybody's going to find out about him.
quote.by: a Group of Five personnel director

557714455:breakout.h: M.O'Dell Is Now an 80, and Texas State Is Running Out of Time
557714455:breakout.d: [[p:557714455|M.O'Dell]] has made a 13-point jump as a freshman receiver. [[t:832438386|Texas State]], 82nd in NIL spending, hasn't paid him a cent yet.

557723934:breakout.h: Pittsburgh's Defensive Breakout Is Going to Get Expensive
557723934:breakout.d: [[p:557723934|D.Fort]] has gone from promising to 85 overall at middle linebacker, up 12 points in a week. [[t:832438367|Pittsburgh]] isn't paying him anything yet, and sources say that has to change soon.

quote.text: Linebackers who play like that don't stay on a free deal. The market corrects itself.
quote.by: a source familiar with the program

557716252:breakout.h: Louisville Has a Star Guard on Its Hands and Nothing in the Budget
557716252:breakout.d: [[p:557716252|M.Ogundeji]] jumped to 83 overall and still earns nothing in NIL. [[t:832438332|Louisville]] ranks 74th in NIL spending, and a sophomore with that growth curve won't stay overlooked.

557719613:buried.h: B.Ghee Is Too Good for the Bench. How Long Does He Wait?
557719613:buried.d: The 83-overall sophomore edge rusher has played just 131 snaps in 16 games. [[p:557719613|B.Ghee]] has people around him asking whether a starting job is waiting elsewhere. Several portal programs would start him on day one.

quote.text: He's a starter somewhere. He knows it, and everybody around him knows it.
quote.by: a person close to the player

557728693:fit.h: With Oregon's Pass Defense Struggling, J.Washington Could Look Elsewhere
557728693:fit.d: [[p:557728693|J.Washington]] is an 89-overall hybrid safety on a defense that ranks 128th of 138 against the pass. Oregon already had to open the wallet for I. Obidegwu, and rival staffers expect that won't be the last such call.

quote.text: If you're an 89 and your defense is giving up yards every week, you start listening.
quote.by: a rival defensive coordinator

557725988:buried.h: A.Rowden Is Stuck on Texas Tech's Bench, and Suitors Know It
557725988:buried.d: An 88-overall sophomore running back with just 6 snaps in 14 games is the kind of player who gets calls. [[p:557725988|A.Rowden]] might not wait around Lubbock much longer.

quote.text: Nobody is giving a back that good six snaps. He's going to want a bigger role.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557727705:struggling.h: T. Hornes Is an 87-Overall Receiver With No Production, and the Staff Is Restless
557727705:struggling.d: [[p:557727705|T.Hornes]] has no catches for no yards in 3 games. His team could shop the portal at his position, and the receiver could look for a new offense. The ratings haven't translated.

quote.text: You can't carry an 87 who isn't getting the ball. Something has to change.
quote.by: an opposing assistant

557717941:buried.h: R.Lucas Is Too Good to Sit, and Portal Teams Are Watching
557717941:buried.d: An 80-overall sophomore edge rusher who has played 143 snaps in 16 games isn't likely to stay patient forever. [[p:557717941|R.Lucas]] would start tomorrow for plenty of programs.

557712883:struggling.h: T.Beard Has Zero Catches at LSU. Is a New Role or New Team Next?
557712883:struggling.d: [[p:557712883|T.Beard]] is an 86-overall receiver with no catches and no yards in 13 games. [[t:832438333|LSU]] keeps adding talent, and he'll have to win the job back in camp.

quote.text: He's a good player, but right now the receiver room is crowded and he's behind.
quote.by: a source close to the LSU program

557725640:struggling.h: T.Norman Was Supposed to Be a Star. The Production Isn't There
557725640:struggling.d: [[p:557725640|T.Norman]] is an 85-overall receiver with only 2 catches for 14 yards in 13 games. On a ranked team, that's not enough, and he'll have to earn the job back in camp.

quote.text: The ratings say star. The film says role player. He needs a big offseason.
quote.by: a source familiar with the program

557728716:sinking.h: R.Wesley on a 2-10 Michigan Team Could Be Portal's Top Prize
557728716:sinking.d: [[p:557728716|R.Wesley]] is an 89-overall sophomore edge rusher on a Michigan team that went 2-10. If he hits the portal, expect a bidding war and an offseason storyline.

quote.text: Every staff in the country would pick up the phone for him. It'd be a frenzy.
quote.by: a rival recruiting coordinator

557716998:sinking.h: Michigan State's Z.Johnson Deserves Better Than 4-9. Contenders Are Circling
557716998:sinking.d: [[p:557716998|Z.Johnson]] is an 89-overall junior running back on a 4-9 Michigan State team. Contenders know his name, and sources say the phones are already warming up.

quote.text: A back like that on a team going nowhere? Somebody's going to make a push.
quote.by: a portal-focused staffer at a power program

561124812battle.h: Nebraska Holds the Edge for J. Tyree, But LSU Is Pushing Hard
561124812battle.d: Nebraska is in front for [[r:561124812|J. Tyree]], with LSU close behind and Georgia lurking. Playing time is his dealbreaker, and both staffs are expected to spend the week selling him on an early role.

quote.text: He's heard 'you'll play' from everybody. Now he wants to see the depth chart.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

557719613:stayed:2027.h: B. Ghee Stays at Ohio State Despite Portal Watch Buzz
557719613:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557719613|B.Ghee]] spent a week on Portal Watch as a buried name on the depth chart. The portal is open, and he's still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster. Staff conversations appear to have mattered.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557717941:stayed:2027.h: R. Lucas Isn't Leaving Ohio State, Whatever the Depth Chart Says
557717941:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557717941|R.Lucas]] was on Portal Watch for a week and is still in the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] fold. After a rough stretch of departures in Columbus, a player who stays is news. Tuddy_roosevelt's staff will take it.

quote.text: He's not looking for the exit. He wants to earn it here.
quote.by: a person close to the player

557717405:stayed:2027.h: C. Knighten Stays Put at East Carolina as Portal Chatter Fades
557717405:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557717405|C.Knighten]] was a Portal Watch name for a week, stuck down the depth chart. He's still on the [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] roster. Pirate_flag's staff apparently made the case for patience.

quote.text: Coaches were straight with him about the plan. He appreciated that.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557726994:stayed:2027.h: L. Bey Is Staying at Ohio State, Scheme Concerns and All
557726994:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557726994|L.Bey]] was flagged as a bad scheme fit, yet he's still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster with the portal open. Staying is one thing. Finding a role in this system is the harder part.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557716955:breakout.h: Freshman Receiver C. Woods Is Surging, and Ohio State Will Have to Pay
557716955:breakout.d: [[p:557716955|C.Woods]] has jumped to 81 overall and is earning 55K in NIL. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has the deepest pockets in the country, but rival staffs are reportedly taking note of a freshman who's outplaying his deal.

quote.text: That number is going up soon. If it doesn't, someone else will make the call.
quote.by: a rival staffer

557722886:breakout.h: Ohio State Edge L. Jerman Is Climbing Fast and Due a Bigger Check
557722886:breakout.d: The freshman pass rusher is now 78 overall on a 125K NIL deal. [[p:557722886|L.Jerman]] is a good problem for [[t:832438359|Ohio State]], which has the resources to keep him. Whether it acts before rivals call is the question.

557713589:breakout.h: Penn State's K. Wilkes Is Playing Above His 85K Deal
557713589:breakout.d: [[p:557713589|K.Wilkes]] has climbed to 79 overall as a freshman receiver. [[t:832438366|Penn State]] has the second-deepest NIL pockets nationally, and agerm40's staff is expected to adjust his deal before the portal market gets ideas.

quote.text: You don't wait on a kid like that. You get ahead of it.
quote.by: a Big Ten staffer

557713201:fit.h: M. Carver Is a Coverage Safety on a Defense That Can't Cover
557713201:fit.d: [[p:557713201|M.Carver]] is an 80-overall coverage specialist at [[t:832438366|Penn State]], which ranks 126th of 138 in pass defense. Agents and rival staffs are reportedly watching to see if he tests the market.

quote.text: Guys like that want to play on a defense that lets them make plays. That's a fair question to ask.
quote.by: an NFL-connected agent

557726198:underpaid.h: J. Smith Is an 89-Overall Safety Making Nothing, and Georgia Should Worry
557726198:underpaid.d: [[p:557726198|J.Smith]] earns nothing in NIL while safeties of his caliber go for around 110K. Georgia has the third-deepest pockets in the country, but rival collectives are reportedly circling a star who's well underpaid.

quote.text: Everybody knows the market. He's got to be hearing from people.
quote.by: a rival collective source

557717478:underpaid.h: Texas Is Getting a Bargain at QB in K. Lacey Jr., But Not for Long
557717478:underpaid.d: [[p:557717478|K.Lacey Jr.]] is an 85-overall quarterback on 55K, while similar passers go for around 155K. [[t:832438384|Texas]] has the pockets to fix it. Others have noticed the gap.

quote.text: A quarterback like that gets calls every week. Texas can't ignore it.
quote.by: a rival staffer

557713038:buried.h: B. Lyle Is Stuck Behind the Starter at Ohio State, and Teams Are Watching
557713038:buried.d: [[p:557713038|B.Lyle]] is an 82-overall sophomore quarterback with just 5 snaps in 16 games. Someone in the portal market would start him tomorrow, and the depth chart in Columbus offers no clear path.

quote.text: He's too good to sit this long. His people are listening to offers.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557715455:underpaid.h: J. Gordon Is a Star Running Back Without an NIL Deal, and Rivals Know It
557715455:underpaid.d: [[t:832438383|Tennessee]]'s [[p:557715455|J.Gordon]] is an 85-overall back earning nothing while peers at his rating command around 60K. Rival collectives are circling, and the Volunteers face a portal fight if they don't act.

quote.text: The offers will come. The only question is whether Tennessee matches them.
quote.by: a rival collective source

557725852:buried.h: D. Quinn Is Third on Ohio State's Depth Chart and Unlikely to Wait
557725852:buried.d: [[p:557725852|D.Quinn]] is an 81-overall sophomore edge rusher who hasn't played a snap in 16 games. With the portal open, plenty of programs would start him. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] could lose another body.

quote.text: He's frustrated. Nobody can blame him if he looks elsewhere.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557713038:stayed:2027.h: B. Lyle passes on the portal, stays buried and patient at Ohio State
557713038:stayed:2027.d: After a week on Portal Watch, [[p:557713038|B.Lyle]] is still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster with the window open. Buried on the depth chart, he has decided the grass isn't obviously greener elsewhere.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557725852:stayed:2027.h: D. Quinn was on our list. Ohio State says he's going nowhere
557725852:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557725852|D.Quinn]] sat a week on Portal Watch as a depth-chart casualty, but he remains at [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. Per a source, Tuddy_roosevelt's staff sat down with him early and the message landed.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557716955:stayed:2027.h: C. Woods stays at Ohio State, and the bill is coming
557716955:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557716955|C.Woods]] came off Portal Watch still wearing scarlet, but his rating jump means other collectives will keep calling. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has deep pockets, and a source says an extension conversation is expected.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557722886:stayed:2027.h: L. Jerman won't test the market, to Ohio State's relief
557722886:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557722886|L.Jerman]] rose enough to draw interest, but he's staying at [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. Rival staffs reportedly checked in anyway. The Buckeyes now have to prove loyalty gets rewarded.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557711879:breakout.h: Freshman corner J. Blue is now an 85, and Ohio State has a decision
557711879:breakout.d: [[p:557711879|J.Blue]] jumped eight points thanks to Impact development, and he's already earning 110K in NIL, well above the 50K median for corners his rating. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] is first nationally in NIL strength, so a raise is easy. Keeping rivals away is the harder part.

quote.text: He's already paid like a star. Nobody's complaining in that room, but other schools are calling.
quote.by: a rival staffer

557719002:breakout.h: N. Pullard's leap to 85 puts Penn State's NIL budget to work
557719002:breakout.d: The sophomore corner is up six points on Elite development and earning 60K, a bit above the 50K median for his rating. [[t:832438366|Penn State]] ranks second nationally in NIL, and agerm40 has reason to lock him in before his stock climbs any more.

quote.text: Corners like that don't stay quiet once the portal chatter starts.
quote.by: a league scout

557726994:fit.h: L. Bey, an 89-overall weapon, is stuck in a passing game that barely functions
557726994:fit.d: [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] ranks 121st of 138 in receptions, a rough landing for a threat back like [[p:557726994|L.Bey]]. Per a source, his camp has noticed. Players in his spot often listen to offers, and Tuddy_roosevelt needs a plan.

quote.text: You don't want a guy like that touching it a handful of times in the passing game. He'll look around.
quote.by: a source familiar with the situation
